bmi_calculator.title: BMI Calculator
bmi_calculator.description: Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) and get health advice. Supports metric and US units, instant calculation.
bmi_calculator.what_is_bmi_desc: BMI (Body Mass Index) is a value derived from the mass and height of a person. It is used to categorize underweight, normal weight, overweight, and obesity in adults.
bmi_calculator.how_to_calculate_desc: BMI = weight (kg) / [height (m)]². For US units: BMI = [weight (lb) / (height (in))²] × 703.
bmi_calculator.health_advice_desc: Maintain a balanced diet, exercise regularly, get enough sleep, and consult a doctor for personalized advice.
bmi_calculator.healthy_range: Healthy BMI range: 18.5 - 24.9 kg/m² (WHO International Standard)
bmi_calculator.input_tip: Please fill in the information. Calculation is automatic.
bmi_calculator.disclaimer: BMI is for reference only. For specific health conditions, consult a professional doctor.
bmi_calculator.page_title: Free BMI Calculator - Online Body Mass Index Calculator Tool | TinyToolFlare
bmi_calculator.page_description: Free online BMI calculator supporting metric/US units, automatic body mass index calculation, healthy weight ranges, and BMI classification. Provides adult and children/adolescent BMI standards, professional health assessment tool.
bmi_calculator.page_keywords: BMI calculator, body mass index, weight index calculation, healthy weight, online BMI tool, free calculator, health assessment, weight management, body mass index calculator
bmi_calculator.formula_note_1: Metric units: weight in kilograms (kg), height in meters (m)
bmi_calculator.formula_note_2: US units: weight in pounds (lb), height in inches (in), multiplied by conversion factor 703
bmi_calculator.formula_note_3: BMI calculation results are for reference only. For specific health conditions, please consider body fat percentage, waist circumference and other indicators comprehensively.
bmi_calculator.adult_standards_note: * Reference World Health Organization (WHO) standards. Some Asian countries set the "normal" upper limit to 23.9.
bmi_calculator.bmi_explanation: BMI (Body Mass Index) is an internationally recognized indicator for measuring human body fatness and health risks. It evaluates individual weight status through the ratio of weight to height, applicable to most adults. BMI calculation is simple and widely used in epidemiological surveys and clinical assessments.
bmi_limitations: BMI mainly reflects total body fat content and cannot distinguish between fat and muscle.
For special populations such as athletes, pregnant women, and the elderly, BMI is for reference only.
Both high and low BMI may increase the risk of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and diabetes.

uuid_generator.title: UUID Generator
uuid_generator.description: Quickly generate unique UUIDs for development, databases, and more.
uuid_generator.about_desc:
A UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) is a 128-bit number used to uniquely identify information. It is usually represented as a 32-character hexadecimal string.

UUIDs are widely used for database primary keys, distributed systems, session identifiers, unique filenames, and more, ensuring global uniqueness.

The most common version is UUID v4, which is randomly generated and virtually impossible to duplicate. UUIDs can be generated without central coordination, making them ideal for distributed environments.

icon_generator.faq_what_is_favicon_desc:
A favicon is a small icon displayed in browser tabs, bookmarks, and mobile shortcuts.

Main purposes of a favicon:
- Helps users quickly identify your site among many tabs
- Enhances brand identity and professionalism
- Adapts to mobile, PWA, desktop shortcuts, and more
- May appear in search engine results for better exposure

Common formats are .ico and .png. It is recommended to provide multiple sizes for best compatibility.
icon_generator.faq_why_favicon_desc:
1. Brand Identity: A unique favicon helps users spot your site among many tabs.
2. Professionalism: Sites with favicons look more trustworthy and polished.
3. Multi-device Support: Favicons are used for mobile, PWA, desktop shortcuts, and more.
4. SEO: Some search engines display your favicon in search results.
5. Better UX: Users can easily find your site in bookmarks, history, and desktop shortcuts.

2. Select the sizes and output format (PNG/ICO), multiple selection supported.
3. (Optional) Set grayscale or custom color style for different design needs.
4. Click 'Generate' to preview all styles and sizes.
5. Click 'Download' to get a zip package with all generated icons.
6. Copy the HTML code snippet below and paste it into your site's <head>.
7. Upload the generated icon files to your website root directory.
